seed_data_creation: Created test images using PIL with PAN number, Aadhaar number, MSME registration text drawn on them for AI OCR testing
context_for_next_testing_agent: KYC auto-approve/auto-reject fully working. When vendors upload documents via POST /api/vendors/kyc/upload/{doc_type}: 1) AI verifies document using GPT-4o-mini vision, 2) If verified with high confidence and no mismatches -> auto_action='auto_approved', doc status='approved', 3) If mismatch_detected or invalid_document -> auto_action='auto_rejected', doc status='rejected' with AI reason, 4) If all 4 required docs are auto-approved -> auto_action='full_kyc_auto_approved', kyc_status='approved', 5) PDFs skip AI and need manual review. Admin can override any auto-decision. Razorpay and Instagram Auto-DMs are MOCKED.
